tables.name: Visitor Traffic
tables.description: How many frequent the city on a temporary basis. Modifies Night Activity. Optionally, 0 or less could mean a forsaken city.

results.name: Mostly Locals
results.description: On any given day, there are typically a few from outside the city, though not enough to impact congestion. (+0 to night activity roll)

results.name: Groups
results.description: There are generally a fair amount of visitors to the city. May slightly increase congestion. (+1 to night activity roll)

results.name: Crowds
results.description: A noticeable amount of people come through the city on a regular basis. Congestion is increased. (+2 to night activity roll)

results.name: Droves
results.description: Large groups of people regularly frequent the city. Congestion is significantly increased. (+3 to night activity roll)

results.name: Masses
results.description: Huge groups of people always seem to be visiting. Congestion could cause difficulties if the city is unable to cope with very large amounts of people. (+4 to night activity roll)

results.name: Multitudes
results.description: Massive groups of people throng the streets, likely spilling out onto the roads outside the city. Congestion is an ever-present reality and a regular issue. (+5 to night activity roll)
